description: DEFAULT DATA (no rule) for the epistemic-gap goal layer (deception vs introspection-gap humility architecture), so the epistemic EVIDENCE auto-produces on an article read. Ships ONLY graph DATA: the MethodSpec the agent AUTHORS the evidence classify-by-join from, plus the EpistemicSignal codebook (structural/documentary/behavioural signals with lean+weight; stylistic cues weighted ~0 -- 'it was never about how they said it'), the ForcedChoiceExpectation socioeconomic model (actor_type -> structural_interest/stakes/actor_can_introspect: oil_company KNOWS renewables threaten it -> deception route; factory_worker can't introspect its forced choice -> introspection-gap route), and the ClassBaseline institutional priors (advertiser/politician/pr/corporation -- the 'money and power' prior, a class-level discount never a per-act conclusion). The RULE is NOT shipped (agent-authored, _no_shipped_epistemic_evidence_rule). The VERDICT is the context-dependent assess_epistemic_lean COMBINE (moral-asymmetry thresholds, proxy cap at weak_deception, a revisable confidence INTERVAL, residual_other_mass>0 always -- never certainty); the actor's CLASS/TYPE is world-supplied context (annotate_actor_class), the advantage the user names: a better model of the actor's environment than the actor's self-model.

attrs.name: epistemic_evidence
attrs.text: When an evidence candidate's signal_name matches an epistemic signal's name, classify an epistemic evidence.

attrs.name: internal_knowledge_trace
attrs.note: a documentary trace that the actor PRIVATELY acknowledged the true goal (an ingested statement / explicit marker) -- the only near-decisive cue; never inferred from stylistic text.

attrs.name: consistent_directional_asymmetry
attrs.note: the actor's acts lean the same divergent direction across N independent observations -- a pattern, not one act.

attrs.name: scrutiny_contingent_competence
attrs.note: the stated goal is pursued competently only when observed/scrutinised -- an awareness-implying structural signal.

attrs.name: coordination_requires_dual_goal
attrs.note: the trajectory needs a joint stated+hidden goal to cohere. PROXY-CAPPED: the honest inverse-planning model is UNBUILT, so this rests on the TemporalConflictReading proxy and can NEVER reach strong_deception.

attrs.name: clear_served_interest
attrs.note: a divergent interest is visibly served by the act -- weak, behavioural.

attrs.name: isolated_incoherent_act
attrs.note: one act that does not cohere with the stated goal, no pattern -- leans confusion/self-opacity, not deliberate deception.

attrs.name: no_served_interest_visible
attrs.note: no divergent interest is visibly served -- leans introspection-gap.

attrs.name: fluent_sincere_rationalisation
attrs.note: a fluent, sincere-sounding account -- STYLISTIC: recorded, must never move the verdict off UNDETERMINED on its own.

attrs.name: hedging_distancing
attrs.note: hedges / distancing language -- a DEBUNKED cue: recorded, weight 0.0, NEVER weighted.
sector instantiation of the company money/power prior: an oil company's profit/market position is threatened by renewables adoption; it KNOWS this. HIGH stakes -- its core business is at risk.
the SAME money/power prior in a DIFFERENT sector -- generalises beyond oil: a pharma company's profit is threatened by cheap generics; it KNOWS this. HIGH stakes.
the political money/power prior: a stated principled reason that cuts against re-election/funder relations is strategic; the actor KNOWS its power incentive.

the INDIVIDUAL case: a person can genuinely rationalise a structurally-forced choice as free principle -- can_introspect 0.0 routes to INTROSPECTION-GAP, not deception (no bad faith). Real but personal stakes (their job).
a TRIVIAL-stakes divergence: little money/power rides on the choice, so the structural prior is weak -- stays UNDETERMINED. Shows UNDETERMINED is the low-stakes case, not over-caution.
advertising is a persuasion register everyone already discounts -- a small class-level prior toward deception, never a per-act conclusion.
campaign speech is read with a standing discount; a class-level prior only.
public-relations output is liability/interest-shaped by trade -- a slightly higher class prior, still never per-act evidence.
a corporate voice serves a fiduciary interest; a modest class-level prior.
